description: Recipient/custody compatibility lens. Bridges/escrows that deliver NFTs/tokens to a recipient via safeTransferFrom/mint can permanently lock assets when the recipient is a contract lacking onERC721Received/onERC1155Received, or when a failed delivery has no retry/recovery path, or when custody accounting marks an asset released while it stays trapped. Recovers ArkProject AK-M2. Advisory recall lens — never blocks.

non_receiver_lock.review_hint: Asset delivered via safeTransferFrom/safeMint to a recipient taken from the message; if that recipient is a contract without onERC721Received/onERC1155Received the transfer reverts and the asset is permanently stuck (no alternate recipient possible).

safe_vs_raw_transfer.review_hint: Mix of raw transfer/transferFrom vs safe* — verify the intended semantics (raw can silently strand to non-receivers; safe can revert-lock).

no_retry_recovery.review_hint: Delivery/withdraw path with no retry/recover/redeliver function — a single failed delivery permanently locks the asset.

custody_released_but_trapped.review_hint: Escrow accounting marks the asset released/cleared but the delivery can revert or the asset remains held — custody state diverges from reality.
